title: Paint event inspector
blurb: Eleven elements drawn by one canvas: a text field, a clock, CSS animations, a video, a marquee, a progress bar. Each flashes when a paint event names it and shows a count, a rate and a strip of its recent events. Three of the animated ones never fire.
question: Which changes to a drawn element raise a paint event that names it, and how often?
result: In Chromium 157 a background animation, a marquee and an animated descendant are named on every frame, a playing 30 fps video about 30 times a second, an indeterminate progress bar 8 times a second and a caret 2 times a second. A transform or opacity animation on the drawable element itself is named once, for its first picture, and never again. The same holds for an element that does not change.
